eyebrow.zh: 离线扫描依赖文档、docstring 和元数据中的可疑指令，给出文件位置、命中规则与 CI 结果。
eyebrow.en: Scan dependency documentation, docstrings and metadata offline for suspicious instructions, with source locations, rule explanations and CI output.

headline.zh: 检查依赖文本中的 Agent 指令。

sub.zh: 离线扫描依赖文档、docstring 和元数据中的可疑指令，给出文件位置、命中规则与 CI 结果。
sub.en: Scan dependency documentation, docstrings and metadata offline for suspicious instructions, with source locations, rule explanations and CI output.

body.zh: 文件、行号和规则名一起输出。
body.en: Output includes file, line and rule.

body.zh: 扫描不向模型发送依赖内容。
body.en: Scanning does not send package content to a model.

body.zh: 规则配置和内容基线支持重复审阅。
body.en: Rule configuration and content baselines support repeated reviews.

body.zh: Agent 会把依赖文档当作上下文阅读。检查可执行代码的流程之外，也需要知道这些文本里是否含有面向 Agent 的祈使句。agentguard 使用内嵌规则和邻近启发式标出值得人工审阅的句子，不执行扫描内容。
body.en: Agents read dependency documentation as context. Alongside code checks, reviewers need to see whether that prose contains instructions addressed to an agent. agentguard uses embedded rules and proximity heuristics to identify sentences for review without executing them.

body.zh: 对仓库自带的合成 npm 与 Go 依赖执行扫描。演示使用 report-only 模式，因此命中规则也不会中断脚本。
body.en: Scan the repository’s synthetic npm and Go dependency fixtures. Report-only mode prevents findings from interrupting the example script.

body.zh: walker 按生态发现 npm、Python、Go 和 Cargo（Rust）依赖，提取文档、源文件中的文档片段及包元数据；detector 使用规则语料与邻近启发式，应用项目规则覆盖后交给 text/SARIF reporter。基线保存全文集合的哈希，增量扫描只检查内容变化。
body.en: The walker discovers npm, Python, Go and Cargo (Rust) dependencies and extracts documents, source-file documentation and package metadata. The detector applies corpus rules and proximity heuristics, then project overrides, before text or SARIF reporting. Baselines retain hashes of the full file set while incremental scans inspect changed content.

body.zh: 扫描范围包括 node_modules、Python 环境、vendor 与 Go 模块缓存，并有通用文档扫描。SARIF 输出可供支持该格式的查看器与 CI 消费；不需要外部模型或 API key。
body.en: Scan routes cover node_modules, Python environments, vendor and Go module caches, with generic document scanning. SARIF is available to compatible viewers and CI systems. No external model or API key is required.

body.zh:
扫描根目录的 `.agentguard.yaml` 支持 `disable`、`allow` 与 `severity`。规则 ID 不区分大小写，禁用或降级规则会改变扫描结果。
```yaml
disable: []
allow: []
severity: {}
```
`--format text|sarif` 选择报告，`--output` 指定文件；`--changed-only` 只略过哈希未变化的 prose 文件。
body.en:
`.agentguard.yaml` at the scan root supports `disable`, `allow` and `severity`. Rule IDs are case-insensitive; disabling or downgrading a rule changes the result.
```yaml
disable: []
allow: []
severity: {}
```
`--format text|sarif` selects reporting and `--output` selects a file. `--changed-only` skips prose files whose hashes have not changed.

body.zh: Go fixture 在默认级别下未出现发现。
body.en: The Go fixture has no findings at the default severity.

body.zh: 当前二进制包含 30 条语料规则。
需要 Go 1.24+。首次构建会下载 go.mod 中的依赖；编译后的扫描可离线运行。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The first build downloads go.mod dependencies; the compiled scanner runs offline.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentguard.git
cd agentguard
go build -o bin/agentguard ./cmd/agentguard

./bin/agentguard check testdata/node_modules_fixture --ecosystem node --no-color --exit-on-finding=false
./bin/agentguard check testdata/go_fixture --ecosystem go --no-color --exit-on-finding=false
./bin/agentguard corpus

limitations.zh: 启发式命中需要人工判断；无发现不代表依赖安全，也不替代漏洞或执行行为分析。
limitations.en: Heuristic findings require review. A clean scan does not establish package safety or replace vulnerability and execution analysis.

limitations.zh: 本示例只验证自带 fixture，未复现大规模扫描耗时或误报率。
limitations.en: The example exercises shipped fixtures; it does not measure large-scale scan time or false-positive rates.

changelog.zh: 新增 Cargo 生态走扫：~/.cargo/registry/src/<index>/<crate>-<version>/ 注册表与 cargo vendor 输出树（vendor 按 Cargo.toml 判别，不再被 Go 枚举器吞掉），每个 crate 贡献 README / CHANGELOG / Cargo.toml [package] description+keywords 三条 prose 通道，finding 定位到真实 manifest 行号；--ecosystem cargo（别名 rust）。
changelog.en: New Cargo ecosystem walker: the ~/.cargo/registry/src/<index>/<crate>-<version>/ registry and cargo vendor output trees (vendor claimed by Cargo.toml presence instead of falling to the Go enumerator); each crate contributes README / CHANGELOG / Cargo.toml [package] description+keywords prose with findings mapped to real manifest lines; --ecosystem cargo (alias rust).

changelog.zh: 源码/清单读取器（docstring、Go 包注释、go.mod、modules.txt）现在对非常规文件做防护，单个恶意包用 FIFO 命名管道不再能挂死扫描；README/package.json/METADATA/源码是符号链接指向扫描根之外时不再被读取（v0.14.0 的 vendor 限制扩展到全部 prose 读取器）；嵌套 /v2 Go 模块缓存目录的标签不再错认 host；Python 包在 dist-info 与包目录里放同一份 README 不再重复报同一条发现。
changelog.en: The source/manifest readers (docstrings, Go package comments, go.mod, modules.txt) now guard against non-regular files, so a FIFO-named file can no longer hang the scan; symlinked README/package.json/METADATA/source files pointing outside the scan root are skipped (v0.14.0's vendor confinement, extended to every prose reader); nested /v2 Go module-cache dirs are labelled with the correct host; and a Python package shipping the same README in both dist-info and package dir no longer reports the same finding twice.

changelog.zh: 「if/when you're an AI」缩写现在能匹配 Unicode 弯引号（U+2019，Markdown 编辑器 / HTML 渲染常见）——此前只认 ASCII 直引号，弯引号版本对 H002 启发式和 AG005 语料都是完全漏报。--ecosystem 打错字（如 nodee / rust）现在会直接报错退出，不再静默返回 0 命中、exit 0 放过一棵带 payload 的依赖树（与 v0.13.0 修 node→npm 别名同一类「最坏失败」）。
changelog.en: The "if/when you're an AI" contraction now matches the Unicode curly apostrophe (U+2019, common from Markdown editors / HTML renderers) — previously only the ASCII straight quote was recognized, so the curly form was a complete false negative for both the H002 heuristic and the AG005 corpus rule. A typo'd --ecosystem (e.g. nodee / rust) now errors out instead of silently returning zero findings and exit 0 on a tree carrying real payloads (the same worst-failure-mode the v0.13.0 node→npm alias fix targeted).

changelog.zh: readPackageJSON 现在对非常规文件（FIFO 命名管道）和超大 package.json 做防护——和 Python、npm-prose 路径一样的 stat + IsRegular + 大小上限，单个恶意包不再能挂死或 OOM 整次扫描。
changelog.en: readPackageJSON now guards against non-regular files (FIFO named pipes) and oversized package.json — the same stat + IsRegular + size cap already used by the Python and npm-prose paths, so a single malicious package can no longer hang or OOM the whole scan.

changelog.zh: vendor/modules.txt 解析现会拦住 ../ 路径穿越（不再把扫描根之外的目录当发现报出）；修复 Go package-clause 与块结束符同行、Python metadata 描述头尾空行等解析边界。
changelog.en: vendor/modules.txt parsing now blocks ../ path traversal (no longer reports directories outside the scan root as findings); fixes Go package-clause on the same line as a block closer, and Python metadata description header trailing-blank parsing edges.

changelog.zh: 扫描符号链接根目录不再静默丢弃整棵依赖树（walk 前先用 EvalSymlinks 解析根）。H002 启发式与语料 AG005 现在能匹配 "if/when you're an AI" 缩写——此前不可达的 '?re 死分支已修复。
changelog.en: Scanning a symlinked root no longer silently drops the entire dependency tree (EvalSymlinks resolves the root before the walk). The H002 heuristic and corpus AG005 now match "if/when you're an AI" contractions — the dead '?re branch is fixed.
